findings.ac: tests/install-harness passes 100% against the new canonical bundle
findings.text: Only run-L1.* and the claude-local/marketplace prompts were retargeted. tests/install-harness/prompts/claude-global.txt still tells the agent to run scripts/install-claude-code.ps1 --global, and that installer errors because dist/claude-code is gone. The antigravity-global.txt and antigravity-local.txt prompts, the antigravity branch of run-L2.py assert_tree (plugins/stratosphere-os/plugin.json, scripts/scaffold.py), and the installer-name check for install-antigravity were not updated. install-antigravity.* now has only dist/antigravity/plugin.json to copy, so L2 cannot pass 100% against dist/skills.

findings.ac: Stress case: missing transitive reference -> build.py exits status 1
findings.text: test_missing_cited_reference_is_a_fatal_build_error calls closure_for('see references/does-not-exist.md', tmp_path), a direct citation with an empty ref_dir. It never exercises the transitive case (an existing reference that cites a missing one, via queue.extend). It asserts only code not in (0, None), not status 1, and does not run build.py as a subprocess. Removing the transitive queue.extend would not fail this test. The shipped-output check in test_skill_conformance only covers dangling citations after a successful build.

findings.ac: build.py succeeds with zero errors and emits exactly 26 skill dirs
findings.text: test_single_bundle_emits_exactly_26_skills counts SKILL.md dirs in the committed dist/skills and never runs build.py. The 'zero errors' and fresh-emit parts are covered only by scripts/check.sh (build, validate and drift), which is not a pytest assertion. A stale committed dist or a build crash would not fail the pytest suite.

tests/scripts/test_install_overlay.py::_require_build still checks dist/claude-code/skills/plan-html, which no longer exists, so every installer test now silently skips. Skipped tests are not a pass against the new bundle, and the legacy install-*.sh/.ps1 scripts remain in the repo pointing at removed dist/claude-code and dist/antigravity trees.
